offers_products.reason: Sells mutual funds, ETFs and other investment strategies packaged as funds under the Virtus brand.

offers_services.reason: Asset management for individual and institutional investors through affiliated managers, such as AlphaSimplex.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Site has an Individual Investor channel; retail investors buy its mutual funds and ETFs.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves institutional investors, consultants and financial professionals, and offers UCITS and QIAIF funds.

recurring_revenue.reason: Earns ongoing management fees on assets under management in funds and separate accounts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Investors hold funds long term. Fee revenue moves with markets, but clients don't easily postpone purchases.

big_ticket.reason: Fund investments are small, frequent purchases, and fees accrue continuously on assets.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from fees on managed fund assets and a fund product platform, not hours of staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual investors and financial advisors, with institutions as a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset manager with investment teams and funds; needs no plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Products vs services is a judgment call for asset management. Fee revenue moves with markets.
